name: Mercure Bangkok Surawong
short_description: A 219-room Mercure in Bangkok's old Thai-Chinese Surawong district with a 4.5/5 ALL Rating (1,421 reviews), a Chinese restaurant, and a rooftop bar.
ai_summary: Mercure Bangkok Surawong is a 219-room hotel in Surawong, one of Bangkok's old Thai-Chinese districts, blending contemporary design with local heritage. The property holds a 4.5/5 ALL Rating from 1,421 reviews. On-site facilities include a Chinese restaurant and a rooftop bar, and the hotel runs a 'Discover Local' programme highlighting authentic food and beverage experiences. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 222 Surawong Road, Si Phraya, Bangrak District, 10500 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 219 rooms with a solid 4.5/5 ALL Rating from a substantial 1,421-review base
Genuine Thai-Chinese heritage district setting, distinct from Bangkok's more generic business districts
On-site Chinese restaurant and rooftop bar, plus a 'Discover Local' F&B programme
cons: Surawong is less central for BTS/MRT access than Silom or Sukhumvit
research_highlights: Chinese restaurant, rooftop bar, 'Discover Local' F&B programme
